headline: Bulls take charge at PSX as KSE-100 gains over 1,200 points
summary: The KSE-100 gained over 1,200 points at the Pakistan Stock Exchange as easing geopolitical tensions and lower global oil prices encouraged buyers. Bullish sentiment drew investors into the market.
why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of Pakistan Stock Exchange's largest listed companies. Oil prices affect Pakistan's import bill and inflation, so energy moves matter to its market.
why_moved: Easing geopolitical tensions and a decline in global oil prices encouraged bullish sentiment and drew buyers into the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
